 About the match
 On this page you can find the Steelers vs Gamba Osaka match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Wednesday 04-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Steelers lines up in a 4-1-4-1 led by Jeon, while Gamba Osaka sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Kurata. Steelers is led by head coach Jae-sung Kim, while Gamba Osaka is managed by Tomokazu Myojin. The match is played at Pohang Steel Yard.
